## Loader interface

A loader as `g.loader()` returns it: keyed by entity `N` of key `K`<!-- -->, its value `V`<!-- -->, the needs,  run values and hints its load reads. Strategies, verifications, hydrators and providers name  it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Loader<N extends string, K, V, Needs extends Attrs, CtxPart, Hints extends Attrs = Empty> extends LoaderBase 
```
**Extends:** [LoaderBase](./hopgraph.loaderbase.md)
